name: Pakaitos Mystical Enhancement
description: The complex construction of the city is a vast and intricate magical circle in itself, created to channel the mystical energies of magic and bring the blessings of Ba-Ka to the citizens. This provides the following effects. Mystical Recovery (Every spellcaster in the city) Spellcasters who complete a short rest within the city regain one expended spell slot of the highest level they can cast. Mystical Stability (Every spellcaster in the city) Spellcasters who need to prepare spells, upon completing a long rest within the city, find they can hold more power than usual. They can prepare two additional spells of any spell level they have slots for. These extra spells remain prepared until the next long rest. Blessing of Ba-Ka (Only worshipers of Ba-Ka) All individuals who worship Ba-Ka receives protection against magic inside the city gaining advantage in all saving throws against magic. This affects not only clerics and paladins but all individuals who truly worship Ba-Ka, an effect that disappears if they lose their faith or betray the god.
